subject: Interim remittance check — ACH pin for partial wire split
messages:
From: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@axiomhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request to split payment for INV1123 (PO attached)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for your patience. Our AP team has asked if we can split payment for invoice INV1123 (PO attached) — 50% via ACH today and the remaining 50% via wire next Tuesday (9/08). Internal approvals are in place but treasury requires a) Redwood's ACH routing/account details in a formatted authorization and b) a remittance reference or ACH PIN we can include on the transfer so our ERP posts the payment to the right invoice.

Can you confirm you can accept a split remittance and provide the formatted ACH authorization (routing/account + payee name + address) and the preferred remittance reference string? If you have a short PDF we can attach to our payment instruction, that would be ideal.

I've attached our PO (PO-AXM-567.pdf) and can loop in our AP lead if useful.

Best,
Maya Thompson
AxiomHealth — Accounts Payable
maya.thompson@axiomhealth.com
Attachment: PO-AXM-567.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@axiomhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to split payment for INV1123 (PO attached)

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for sending the PO. We can accommodate a 50/50 split (ACH today + wire on 2026-09-08). To make sure the payment applies cleanly, please use the remittance reference: AXM-INV1123-REMIT.

Attached is a one-page remittance instruction PDF (redwood-remit-instructions.pdf) with our bank details and a short ACH authorization template you can paste into your treasury system. A couple of quick asks so the posting is immediate on our side:
- Please include the remittance reference exactly as above in the ACH details (company ref/description).
- If your treasury requires an ACH PIN or internal payment token, we accept the PIN string in the memo; confirm the two-digit prefix your system uses and we will approve it on our side.

If you'd like, we can also accept the ACH to an alternative virtual account for immediate reconciliation — let me know and I can share that routing.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-remit-instructions.pdf
From: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@axiomhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AxiomHealth AP <ap@axiomhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request to split payment for INV1123 (PO attached)

Thanks, Olga — that works.

We are sending the ACH for 50% today. Treasury asked that we provide the authorization in their form, so attached is the completed ACH form (ACH-form-AXM.pdf) — account ending in x678, routing 111000025. The authorization includes the payment date and the memo field populated with AXM-INV1123-REMIT.

Action items from our side:
- ACH submit today (we will share the trace number once it's posted).
- Wire for the remaining balance scheduled for 2026-09-08 after PO reconciliation.

Will confirm trace once ACH is live.

Maya
Attachment: ACH-form-AXM.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@axiomhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to split payment for INV1123 (PO attached)

Maya — confirmed, thank you.

We will look for the ACH to post today; please share the Fed trace/reference once it's available so we can reconcile immediately. Expected posting for ACHs to our operating account is 24–48 hours depending on originating bank — if you see it land this afternoon we will allocate 50% to INV1123 and leave the remaining invoice open for the wire.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Reconcile ACH when trace received and post payment to INV1123.
- Hold balance until wire arrives on or before 2026-09-08.
- If you need an alternate virtual account to speed reconciliation, reply and I will send the routing details.

Note: Monica from our collections team will waive the standard late fee for this invoice provided the wire for the balance is received by 2026-09-10.

Thanks again — please send the ACH trace and the wire beneficiary name/PO mapping once scheduled.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

On Tue, 08 Sep 2026 at 12:05:00 -07:00, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
